name: Yakage (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Yakage town emblem in yellow: a disc crossed by a stylised arrow with a hooked end.
history: Municipal flag of Yakage, a town in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 1964.

features.role: Yakage town emblem — a disc crossed by a stylised arrow with a hooked end
